**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Sir](../persons.html#1143),
My new tale of ‘[Heartsease or The Brother's Wife](../books.html#19)’ is now complete. I am willing to publish it in the same manner as the ‘[Heir of Redclyffe](../books.html#13)’ and if you are ready to undertake it, will forward it to you, as soon as I have heard from you.

At your convenience, I should be glad to know the state of the account of [The Little Duke](../books.html#20).

Yours faithfully,

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
